description1: Bearby stores your keys directly on your device, ensuring full control and security without external dependencies.
description2: Bearby collects no user data whatsoever, prioritizing your privacy and autonomy at every step.
description3: Enjoy a smooth and intuitive interface designed for ease of use, backed by robust cryptographic protection.
description4: Leverage top-tier encryption with AES-256, PBKDF2, and BLAKE3 for unmatched security of your assets.
description5: All transactions are signed directly on your hardware, eliminating risks from remote processing.
description6: Benefit from multiple layers of cryptography, ensuring secure storage and transfer of your digital assets.
